notes.title: Patch 3.9 – Update Notes
notes.notes:
Various bug fixes

New skills are now unlocked instantly during the current run, instead of being available only on the next one!

notes.title: Patch Note v0.3.8
notes.notes:
Fixed rounding bug for credits.
Preparation for new zones in the 2D open world.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.2
notes.notes:
V-Sync issue resolved!
New item: Velocity Boots!
Fixed a minor display bug.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.3.0
notes.notes:
🚀 New Features:
New stat gain system between runs:
A redesigned system to make stat improvements even more impactful throughout the game! 💪✨



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728136/a2f940259dec6f3f8bb8ec382062bcc75583bcd0.png

New title screen:
No one cares, but it’s here! 🎉😅

🔧 Optimizations:
Optimized open-world resource management:
Improved handling of monsters and zones to reduce loading times and enhance overall performance. Run loading times are shorter, and Ashes O now runs more smoothly on low-end systems! 🚀🌍

notes.title: Big Content Update! Ashes Beta 0.2.0 is live!!!
notes.notes:
It's the end of the world in 5 minutes. War is raging between V and H, ancient and mystical powers are unleashed. And what fuels the conflicts in these final moments of this world...? Resources and energy, of course!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728136/97218ef9944e4e0d7a7412a742dcdb72f2c3f013.png

Explore the underground, the desert, H's bunker, and V's warships!
Unlock ways to navigate this dying world even faster!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728136/3dbddca594217cd8a634cbf72d106b720744c7f0.png

A constant sense of progression, the first FAST RPG / RogueVania.
YES, we’re inventing genres, but we’re creating something new, so we’re allowed!
